query:
SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) + 1 AS INTEGER) as "rank!: i64"
           FROM (
               SELECT team_id, SUM(points_at_solve) as total
               FROM solves GROUP BY team_id
           ) scores
           WHERE total > (
               SELECT COALESCE(SUM(points_at_solve), 0)
               FROM solves WHERE team_id = ?1
           )
